_about: Public-domain Alexander Maclaren (1826-1910, Baptist minister of Union Chapel, Manchester, for 45 years) for the Word Hoard: Expositions of Holy Scripture (17 CCEL parts covering Genesis to First Timothy), his Expositor's Bible volumes on the Psalms (3 vols) and on Colossians and Philemon, and The Life of David, all clean from CCEL. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
